short: framework objects and their line formats
is: The backend-blind types (tickets, epics, tasks, asks, answers, findings, instances, profiles, ids, labels) and the text formats they travel in, each with its parser, plus the verbatim quote check.
conventions: Imports no other layer, only the crate's text_newtype macro; zaf/tests/architecture.rs fails on a break
A format with rules gets its own error type (AskError, AnswerError, IdError, TaskTemplateError)

fs.name: answer.rs
fs.role: keeper answer: verdict, citations, word limit

fs.name: ask.rs
fs.role: ask record: up to five typed questions

fs.name: epic.rs
fs.role: the Epic entity and its stage derived on read (unsigned, signed, planned, challenged, done), its tasks, and the BodyHash a signature holds

fs.name: instance.rs
fs.role: a role run numbered on its epic, and its slug

fs.name: profile.rs
fs.role: context profiles: lean, build, design, review

fs.name: quote.rs
fs.role: verbatim quote check against the cited page

fs.name: task.rs
fs.role: task ticket template: one Field: value per line

fs.name: ticket.rs
fs.role: the Ticket entity, its title, body and link newtypes, the TicketSummary every --json prints, and Standing with how an issue stands from open, dropped and done

notes: Task fields: Goal, Scope with Out of scope (or Owned paths; Scope wins when both are given), Interfaces, Design pages, Architecture (optional), Acceptance, Tests, Security trigger, Model, Size; check reads Tests, Architecture and Acceptance
Task labels ready, claimed, blocked, question, done and page statuses decided, current, proposed, superseded are the vocabularies shared with the board and design source
Ask kinds are fact, rule, term, exists, where
